$comment: Per-device fixes / driver hints for printers + scanners + MFPs. Keyed by lowercase 'VID:PID' (USB) or by 'make' substring as fallback. Seed entries reflect findings from real installs and the upstream sources: OpenPrinting (openprinting.org/printers), SANE descriptions (sane-project/backends), and OpenPrinting/ipp-usb device_quirks.go. Add new entries here rather than hard-coding shell hacks in install.sh.

04e8:344f.name: Samsung SCX-3400 Series
04e8:344f.notes: Samsung ULD (suld-driver2) provides both the PPD and the smfp SANE backend. xerox_mfp also claims this device but its sane_read() returns I/O errors on M-series Samsungs; sane-usb-init.sh comments xerox_mfp out of /etc/sane.d/dll.conf when smfp.conf is present. smfp requires explicit USB ID entries in smfp.conf (sane_usb_conf:true) because it does not enumerate via libusb like hpaio/pixma.

04a9:*.name: Canon (generic)
04a9:*.notes: Most modern Canon MFPs speak IPP-over-USB + eSCL; ipp-usb + sane-airscan cover them without vendor drivers.

03f0:*.name: HP (generic)
03f0:*.notes: HPLIP is preferred over driverless for older HP devices. hplip-data ships PPDs for ~3000 models.

04b8:*.name: Epson (generic)
04b8:*.notes: Use Epson's escpr driver for current models; the older 'epson' backend has been removed from libsane. epsonscan2 (proprietary) covers ET / WF series; epson2 (SANE) covers older Perfection scanners.

04f9:*.name: Brother (generic)
04f9:*.notes: Most Brother lasers use brlaser. Brother's own brscanX packages are arch-specific and need a per-model deb from their site — not in Debian repos.
